name: Guangzhou Sanfu New Materials Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Guangzhou Sanfu New Materials Technology Co., Ltd. is a surface finishing technology solutions provider, primarily engaged in the research of surface finishing technologies and the development, production, and sales of new environmentally friendly surface finishing specialized chemicals and equipment. Its products are widely used in PCB manufacturing, 3C product manufacturing, automotive parts, hardware and sanitary ware, new energy, and many other industrial fields.
